prayerExcerpt.en-US: Amid the changes of this world, may we constantly look to you alone.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Em meio à agitação deste mundo, nos dediquemos inteiramente ao vosso serviço.

meta.face: A clean-shaven man of about fifty with a long, rectangular face — a high, flat forehead, strong straight brows set low over deep-set grey eyes, a thin, straight, rather long nose, flat, lean cheeks without prominent cheekbones, a firmly squared chin and thin, closed lips; the head shaven with only the narrow Carthusian ring of short dark-brown hair just beginning to grey; eyes lowered, grave and inward, with the faintest peace at the mouth.
meta.basis: No portrait from life exists; the tradition (Le Sueur, Houdon) shows him tonsured, clean-shaven, in the white Carthusian cowl, arms crossed and head bowed. The long, lean, squared face follows Houdon's statue; age from his founding of the Chartreuse in 1084, at about fifty.
